description: This interface defines a service for retrieving dropdown options related to deposit products in a savings portfolio context, such as pre-closure penalties and maturity instructions.

classes.name: DepositsDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve dropdown options for deposit-related configurations.

methods.name: retrievePreClosurePenalInterestOnTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of options for the penal interest type applicable at pre-closure.

methods.name: maturityInstructionOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of maturity instruction options.
